brand_notes: Performa3 M105 (5.25", 8 Ω nominal) is current on Revel US; Audio Advice shows it unavailable/on sale with a "Discontinued" vendor label. Min impedance 3.8 Ω (effectively 4 Ω). ASR reviewer is a Harman dealer (disclosed). Sources: asr-revel-m105, mfr-revel-m105.
takeaways: ASR Klippel: LW ±1.3 dB, f3 60 Hz, sensitivity 84.8 dB vs 86 claimed.
Impedance min 3.8 Ω at ~230 Hz despite 8 Ω rating: effectively-4ohm.
Very clean above 500 Hz; ~8% THD at 100 Hz at 96 dB; ~111 dB before compression at 80 Hz.
Only one Tier A source; no Stereophile/NRC measurement found.
conflicts: Price/status ambiguity: Revel current vs Audio Advice unavailable
